title: ADMU grad tops chemists licensure exam; 6 top chemical technicians exam
summary: A graduate of Ateneo de Manila University was the top scorer in the computer-based licensure examination for chemists, while six tied for first place in the exam for chemical technicians.

blocks.text: A graduate of Ateneo de Manila University-Quezon City campus was the top scorer in the computer-based licensure examination for chemists held earlier this month, while six test takers tied for first place in the licensure exam for chemical technicians.

According to the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), 914 test takers out of 1,197 passed the chemists computer-based licensure examination, while 3,250 test takers out of 3,742 passed the chemical technicians licensure exam.

Both exams were given by the Board of Chemistry at test centers in Metro Manila, Baguio, Butuan, Cagayan de Oro, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Koronadal, Legazpi, Lucena, Pampanga, Rosales, Tacloban, Tuguegarao, Zamboanga and Puerto Princesa.

"The results of examination with respect to two (2) examinees were withheld pending final determination of their liabilities under the rules and regulations governing licensure examinations," the PRC said.

Joaquin Iñigo Gutierrez Castillejos of ADMU-QC achieved the highest score in the chemists licensure exam with 94.70%, while the best performing schools with 50 or more examinees were the University of the Philippines-Los Baños (UPLB) and ADMU-QC, both with a 100% passing rate (60 and 55 passers respectively).
The top performing school with 25 to 49 examinees, meanwhile, is West Visayas State University-La Paz, with all 25 of its test takers passing.
In the licensure examination for chemical technicians, six examinees achieved the top score of 95.00%. They are:

items: John Bryan Rivera Guingab of UPLB
Luther King Amador Jardin of De La Salle University-Manila
Axel Mangao Labing-isa of UP Diliman0
James Philgrey Tee Lim of UP VIsayas-Iloilo City
Raisa Gwen Rosete Salak of Tarlac State University
Dan Feriel Hidalgo Villanueva of Batangas State University-Batangas City

blocks.text: The top performing schools with 50 or more examinees are UPLB, UP Visayas-Iloilo City, and Mapua University-Manila, all with a 100% passing rate (121, 71, and 67 test takers respectively).
